name: veyra-postgres
description: Self-contained PostgreSQL server bootstrapper for generic Node.js 22 hosts (Altare). Installs Postgres if missing, generates SSL certs, writes hardened config, supervises the process, and logs everything to the terminal.

scripts.check: node --check index.mjs && node --check lib/config.mjs && node --check lib/health.mjs && node --check lib/install.mjs && node --check lib/logger.mjs && node --check lib/nativeLibs.mjs && node --check lib/postgres.mjs && node --check lib/procs.mjs && node --check lib/setup.mjs && node --check lib/uidCompat.mjs
